decided.singular: These are the sharp peaks that rise well above the usual 5-25 range: day 1 starts at about 36, days 148-157 reach about 51 (the year's maximum), days 270-276 reach about 35, and days 313-320 reach about 40.
decided.recurrence: From days 40-140 the peaks are evenly spaced, but about 13 days apart (44, 57, 71, 83, 97, 110, 123, 136), so a 27-day cycle would only show as every other peak; in the second half the spacing is irregular, so I could not confirm a period of 20-35 days.
decided.quarter: Q2 has the year's biggest spike (about 51, near day 150) and a long run of peaks around 20-27 from days 92-140, which looks like more total activity than Q4, the runner-up with its peaks at days 300-320.

answer.guess: A geomagnetic activity index such as daily-resolved 3-hourly Kp/ap, with storm days as the spikes.
